description: Look up Georgia standards by their codes (e.g. ['5.NR.1', '3.T.C.1', 'S8P1', 'SS8H1.a']). Returns the matching standards (each with `code`, `statement`, optional `notes` and `path`), plus per-code `alds` (achievement-level descriptions), `assessment_coverage` (Milestones claim, target, approx_points, qualifier), and `assessment_metadata` keyed by assessment_id; the server instructions explain how to read points, qualifiers, and levels. A sub-code (e.g. '5.NR.3.3') with no descriptors of its own shows its parent standard's. A current code written another way (lowercase, an MGSE/ELAGSE/CCGPS prefix) is reported in `normalized_codes`. A retired MGSE math code (K-8 or high school, e.g. 'MGSE5.NF.1', 'MGSE9-12.A.REI.12', 'F.IF.4') is reported in `legacy_codes` with the current standards the Georgia Department of Education links it to and a `status`: exact (one standard, same grade), moved (one standard, another grade), or partial (several); every linked standard is in `items`. Codes that still don't match appear in `unknown_codes` with likely `suggestions`.

codes.description: One or more standard codes, e.g. ['5.NR.1', 'S8P1'].
codes.title: Codes

lang.description: 'es' adds Spanish text (Georgia Homeroom's translation; the official standards are English) beside the English fields. Default 'en'.
